references.text: Here the significance of Abraham and God's promises to him are recalled, reflecting John the Baptist's warning against relying solely on physical descent from Abraham for righteousness.
The call to look to Abraham as their father and learn from his faith and God's promises to him, which provides background for John's point that God can raise up children of Abraham from stones.
The warning against relying on physical descent from Abraham for righteousness, which resembles the message of John the Baptist.
